_instructions.username: The login username. Case-insensitive on login.
_instructions.passwordHash: SHA-256 hash of the user's password. Generate with: const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode('password')); console.log([...new Uint8Array(buf)].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join(''));  in browser console.
_instructions.allowedScripts: Array of script IDs this user can see and select. Must match the 'id' fields in scripts.json. Use null or omit to allow all scripts.
